text:
Maria (CSM): Heads-up — Acme account. Onboarding at ~65% complete, but token burn spiked after they turned on embeddings-heavy search. Renewal conversation starts next month; need a concise cost snapshot + mitigation plan by Wed.

Taylor (Onboarding): Noted. Two onboarding blockers: webhook auth failing intermittently and SSO setup stuck on the identity team's side. ETA?

Nora (AM): Also need a spend breakdown by feature for the renewal note — customer says search caused the jump. Can we show 'what happened' + 'recommended next steps'?

Liam (FinOps): Quick numbers I pulled: daily average tokens last 30d jumped from 1.2M to 4.8M in the last week after search flip. If trend continues: projected next 30d ~150M tokens. With current hosted rates that's a material increase.

Liam (FinOps): ```
current_month: 50M tokens
projected_next30d: 150M tokens
current_rate: $0.0004/token
proj_cost: $60,000
normalized_proj_with_caching: $38,000
```

Ethan (Support): Support logs show many tiny requests hitting the batch endpoint — they're not using client-side batching. Recommend enabling server batching + prefix/KV cache short-term. That will reduce token usage immediately.

Taylor (Onboarding): Webhook fix ETA EOD Tue. SSO needs an infra change (idp cert rotation) — target Thu. I'll add both items to the playbook and surface blockers to infra.

Nora (AM): For the customer-facing doc I want: 1) brief explanation of spike, 2) short-term mitigations we can do now, 3) expected cost impact if we do nothing vs with mitigations.

Maria (CSM): Liam — can you write two bullets for the AM: quick wins (what to enable this week) and strategic options (dedicated capacity / committed commit)? Keep it <5 lines.

Liam (FinOps): Draft bullets: 1) Quick wins: enable request batching, add 90s prefix/KV cache, and switch search to embeddings-only path for heavy queries — est 25–35% token reduction. 2) Strategic: consider Dedicated or monthly committed capacity for predictable unit economics and enable autoscaling to avoid costly bursts.

DevOps Bot: deploy-batcher: canary deploy scheduled for Tue 06:00 UTC :rocket:

Maria (CSM): Perfect. I'll assemble a one-page snapshot (numbers + 3 recommended actions) and share with Product + AM. @Taylor capture onboarding blockers in the playbook and tag eng when SSO ticket is created.

Taylor (Onboarding): Will do — uploading the checklist to the shared drive after SSO ticket creation.

Nora (AM): :thumbsup: Thanks all. Let's sync 3pm Fri to finalize the customer-facing note and confirm mitigation rollout windows.
